newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end lower, Unimarc shines.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end lower, Unimarc shines.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed broadly lower in thin dealing with Chile's latest Wall Street launch, supermarket chain Unimarc, rising over three percent, said traders.
The bolsa is expected to resume its decline at the opening as players continue to cash in gains from last week's rally, they said.
"It's likely that the correction will contine for the next few days, although getting gradually weaker," said one dealer.
The 40-share index ended down 0.76 percent at 119.56 points.
The general index shed 0.55 percent to 5,346.46 points amid turnover of 6.4 billion pesos.
Unimarc rallied on strong demand among local and foreign investors for the stock, which started trading on Wall Street Friday, said dealers.
"The market keeps asking for Unimarc stocks because of the good outlook for the supermarket business," said one dealer.
In Santiago, Unimarc rose 3.1 percent to 158 pesos, while the firm's ADRs surged 4.14 percent to 18-7/8.
Other winners included drug-maker LabChile, which rose 3.48 percent to 476 pesos.
